title: Economic Planning Meaning Objectives Strategies
definition: Economic planning refers to the conscious and deliberate utilization of a country's available resources by a central authority to achieve predetermined socio-economic objectives over a specified timeframe. In the Indian context, it evolved from centralized directive planning under the Planning Commission to cooperative and competitive federalism under NITI Aayog.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper III (Indian Economy and issues relating to planning, mobilization of resources, growth, development, and employment). UPSC frequently tests the structural shifts from Five-Year Plans to perspective planning, the role of indicative planning, and the evolution of federal planning mechanisms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Economic Planning Meaning Objectives Strategies.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of capitalist, socialist, and mixed economic systems
